title: Legion operator
description: Everything about one operator except its definition.md: .legion/operators/<operator>/operator.json. Legion checks this file with `legion check` before starting the operator.

model.description: Claude model for this operator: opus, sonnet, haiku or a full model id. Passed as --model. Leave it out to use LEGION_MODEL from .legion/squad.

configMode.description: layered loads your own ~/.claude settings too; isolated skips them. Leave it out to use LEGION_CONFIG_MODE from .legion/squad.

scale.description: Lets the operator run as several copies (<operator>, <operator>-2, …). true means up to 5; a number sets the most copies. Leave it out for a single copy.

allowedTools.description: Claude Code tool rules that run without asking, passed as --allowedTools.

disallowedTools.description: Claude Code tool rules that are blocked, passed as --disallowedTools.

settings.description: A normal Claude Code settings object (hooks, env, …), passed as --settings.

mcpServers.description: MCP servers for this operator, keyed by name, passed as --mcp-config.
